SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S.2. Special Branch
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY File No. N. D 2554/24 D 6 / 7 / 33）
Date July 5, 1933.

Subject (in full) Communist Meeting in Western Chapei.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [签名] D.I.

Agents A-3278 and 6459 report that a meeting was held by six communist adherents on a piece of vacant ground near the Yoong Yu (永豫) Cotton Mill, Tan Ka Doo(谈家渡), Western Chapei, between 8 and 9 a.m. July 5, 1933 when the following resolutions were passed :-

1) That a street demonstration be held in the vicinity of the new market, Ferry Road, between 8 and 9 a.m. July 9 in commemoration of the Anniversary of the Inauguration of the First Conference of the Red Labour International.

2) That Siao Kuh (小葛), a newly appointed executive officer of the Shanghai Western Special District Committee of the local Chinese Communist Party, be appointed to supervise the demonstration.

3) That arrangements be made to take over the work of the Communist Party in the Western District.

4) That the activities of the lower ranks in various industrial concerns in Western District be reorganized.

The meeting was presided over by Siao Woo(小吴), a newly appointed executive officer of the Shanghai Western Special District Committee of the local Communist Youth League, whose description is as follows :-

Age 22, native of Hunan, height 5' 4", round face, stout build, parted hair, usually dresses in blue cotton clothing.

The description of Siao Kuh who is mentioned in Resolution No.2 is as follows :-

Age 22, native of Yen Chen(鹽城), Kompo, height 5'5", slim build, dark complexion, short cropped hair, dresses in blue cotton clothing.

报告
S.2. 特别股
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别股登记处 档案号 N. D 2554/24 D 6 / 7 / 33）
日期：1933年7月5日。

主题（全称）：闸北西部共产党会议。

由督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）撰写。由 [签名] 督察转发。

探员 A-3278 和 6459 报告称，1933年7月5日上午8时至9时之间，六名共产党追随者在闸北西部谈家渡永豫棉纱厂附近的一块空地上举行了一次会议，会上通过了以下决议：-

1) 为纪念赤色职工国际第一次代表大会成立周年，于7月9日上午8时至9时之间，在 ferry Road（摆渡路）新市场附近举行街头示威。

2) 任命当地中国共产党上海西区特别委员会新任执行委员小葛（Siao Kuh）负责监督此次示威活动。

3) 安排接管西区共产党的工作。

4) 重组西区各工业企业中下层人员的活动。

会议由当地共产主义青年团上海西区特别委员会新任执行委员小吴（Siao Woo）主持，其体貌特征如下：-

年龄22岁，湖南籍，身高5英尺4英寸，圆脸，体格粗壮，分头发型，通常身穿蓝色棉布衣服。

决议第2条中提到的小葛（Siao Kuh）的体貌特征如下：-

年龄22岁，江苏盐城籍，身高5英尺5英寸，身材瘦削，肤色黝黑，短发，身穿蓝色棉布衣服。
